text: Hypothesis: The bug is in `tenacity/retry.py`, `retry_if_exception_type._check`. It currently checks `type(e) in types`, which only matches an exception whose exact class is configured and excludes subclasses. This also affects the default `Exception` policy and tuple configurations. I intend to replace that exact-type comparison with `isinstance(e, self.exception_types)`, which naturally supports subclasses and tuples of exception types.
